description: This file contains unit tests for the `GrainCancellationToken` functionality within the Orleans framework, testing task cancellations, token callbacks, cross-silo and intra-silo communication, and cancellation propagation in grains.

classes.name: GrainCancellationTokenTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for various aspects of grain cancellation tokens, including task cancellation, callback execution, cross-silo cancellation, and propagation of cancellation exceptions.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture class configuring the Orleans testing cluster and silo behavior, including logging setup.

classes.name: SiloConfig
classes.description: Silo configuration class setting up logging for the test cluster.

methods.name: MultipleGrainsTaskCancellation

methods.name: GrainTaskMultipleCancellations

methods.name: GetGrains
